fields.name: task
fields.label: Task
fields.description:
Start by placing your drop zones.
Next, place your droppable elements and check off the appropriate drop zones.
Last, edit your drop zone again and check off the correct answers.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Choose the type of content you would like to add.

fields.name: backgroundOpacity
fields.label: Background Opacity
fields.description: Reducing the opacity may result in an insufficient contrast and make the content not accessible.

fields.name: multiple
fields.label: Infinite number of element instances
fields.description: Clones this element so that it can be dragged to multiple drop zones.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.description: The label is used by assistive technologies.

fields.name: labelPosition
fields.label: Label position
fields.description: Where the visible label appears. Inside positions overlay the drop zone without changing its size.

fields.name: visualScale
fields.label: Icon or image size
fields.description: 100% is the default size. Lower values make it smaller; higher values make it larger.

fields.name: zoneImage
fields.label: Drop zone image
fields.description: Image shown above the label.

fields.name: zoneIcon
fields.label: Drop zone icon
fields.description: Font Awesome icon shown above the label.

fields.name: backgroundOpacity
fields.label: Background Opacity
fields.description: Reducing the opacity may result in an insufficient contrast and make the content not accessible.

fields.name: feedbackOnCorrect
fields.label: Message displayed on correct match
fields.description: Message will appear below the task on "check" if correct droppable is matched.

fields.name: feedbackOnIncorrect
fields.label: Message displayed on incorrect match
fields.description: Message will appear below the task on "check" if the match is incorrect.

fields.name: single
fields.label: This drop zone can only contain one element
fields.description: Make sure there is only one correct answer for this dropzone

fields.name: autoAlign
fields.label: Enable Auto-Align
fields.description: Will auto-align all draggables dropped in this zone.

fields.name: overallFeedback
fields.label: Define custom feedback for any score range
fields.description: Click the "Add range" button to add as many ranges as you need. Example: 0-20% Bad score, 21-91% Average Score, 91-100% Great Score!

fields.name: feedbackTextAlign
fields.label: Text alignment
fields.description: Only used when no feedback image is set. With an image, text alignment follows image position (left/right: left aligned, above: centered).

name: behaviour
label: Behavioural settings
description: These options will let you control how the task behaves.

fields.name: singlePoint
fields.label: Give one point for the whole task
fields.description: Disable to give one point for each draggable that is placed correctly.

fields.label: Apply penalties
fields.name: applyPenalties
fields.description: Apply penalties for elements dropped in the wrong drop zones. This must be enabled when the same element(s) are able to be dropped into multiple drop zones, or if there is only one drop-zone. If this is not enabled, learners may match all items to all drop-zones and always receive a full score.

fields.name: enableScoreExplanation
fields.label: Enable score explanation
fields.description: Display a score explanation to user when checking their answers (if the 'Apply penalties' option has been selected).

fields.name: backgroundOpacity
fields.label: Background opacity for draggables
fields.description: If this field is set, it will override opacity set on all draggable elements. This should be a number between 0 and 100, where 0 means full transparency and 100 means no transparency

fields.name: dropZoneHighlighting
fields.label: Drop Zone Highlighting
fields.description: Choose when to highlight drop zones.

fields.name: enableFullScreen
fields.label: Enable FullScreen
fields.description: Check this option to enable the full screen button.

fields.name: showScorePoints
fields.label: Show score points
fields.description: Show points earned for each answer. Not available when the 'Give one point for the whole task' option is enabled.

fields.name: showTitle
fields.label: Show Title
fields.description: Uncheck this option if you do not want this title to be displayed. The title will only be displayed in summaries, statistics etc.

fields.name: shuffleInitialPositions
fields.label: Shuffle initial positions
fields.description: Randomize the starting positions of elements on the canvas. Correct answers and drop zones are not changed.

name: feedbackHeader
label: Header for panel containing feedback for correct/incorrect answers

name: scoreBarLabel
label: Textual representation of the score bar for those using a readspeaker

name: scoreExplanationButtonLabel
label: Textual representation of the score explanation button

name: feedbackPopupCloseLabel
label: Text for the feedback popup close button

name: showFeedbackButtonLabel
label: Text for the button that reopens the feedback popup

name: a11yCheck
label: Assistive technology label for "Check" button
default: Check the answers. The responses will be marked as correct, incorrect, or unanswered.

name: a11yRetry
label: Assistive technology label for "Retry" button
default: Retry the task. Reset all responses and start the task over again.
